N.73.summary: Ferdinand to Vich at Rome, 26 Oct 1515: he is displeased that through the Swiss's pride and folly in not waiting for his army, and the slowness of his viceroy and captain general, all of Italy is in danger, and still more at the weakness of the Pope, who is set on coming to terms with the French against the league's capitulation that no confederate may make peace or truce without the others; he does not believe the Pope will keep anything else, and Vich is to strengthen him on his behalf.

system: Homophonic letter signs (37 sign types, including letter-pair signs) mixed with three-letter code groups for words, syllables and single letters (159 group types); word values such as que, por, papa, Italia, liga. Not the 1511-12 nomenclator.
